issue.title: [9332][platform_tests] test_power_off_reboot fails since reboot-cause is not recognized after power-cycle

failure.body:
#### Description

Platform API is not recognizing reboot-cause after powercycle of 9332.

```
show reboot-cause
Unknown
root@str2-z9332f-01:~# show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause        Time                             User    Comment
-------------------  -----------  -------------------------------  ------  ---------
2021_08_26_14_08_39  Unknown      N/A                              N/A     N/A
2021_08_26_13_58_46  reboot       Thu 26 Aug 2021 <IPV6> PM UTC  admin   N/A
2021_08_26_13_52_18  reboot       Thu 26 Aug 2021 <IPV6> PM UTC  admin   N/A
2021_08_26_13_46_27  reboot       Thu 26 Aug 2021 <IPV6> PM UTC  admin   N/A
2021_08_26_13_36_41  Unknown      N/A                              N/A     N/A
2021_08_26_13_29_37  warm-reboot  Thu 26 Aug 2021 <IPV6> PM UTC  admin   N/A
2021_08_26_13_23_24  fast-reboot  Thu 26 Aug 2021 <IPV6> PM UTC  admin   N/A
2021_08_26_13_17_23  soft-reboot  Thu 26 Aug 2021 <IPV6> PM UTC  admin   N/A
2021_08_26_13_12_04  reboot       Thu 26 Aug 2021 <IPV6> PM UTC  admin   N/A
2021_08_26_12_17_48  reboot       Thu 26 Aug 2021 <IPV6> PM UTC  admin   N/A
```
Syslogs
```
Aug 26 <IPV6>.494124 str2-z9332f-01 INFO determine-reboot-cause: Platform api returns reboot cause Non-Hardware, None
Aug 26 <IPV6>.494340 str2-z9332f-01 INFO determine-reboot-cause: Platform api indicates reboot cause Non-Hardware
Aug 26 <IPV6>.494484 str2-z9332f-01 INFO determine-reboot-cause: /host/reboot-cause/reboot-cause.txt indicates the reboot cause: Unknown
```
#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Powercycle device and check reboot-cause using 'show reboot-cause' or
2. Run platform_tests/test_reboot.py::test_power_off_reboot

#### Describe the results you received:
Reboot-cause shows as "Unknown" after power-cycle

#### Describe the results you expected:
Reboot-cause should be "Power Loss"

resolution.title: DellEMC: Z9332f fix reboot cause issue
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
Power cycle test case fails for Z9332f in sonic-mgmt framework(Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8605).
#### How I did it
Modified the platform API to return expected strings.
#### How to verify it
1. Power cycle the device and verify the reboot reason.
2. Run sonic-mgmt test_reboot script.
